recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.subtitle: Named sets of (tag, value) pairs. The operator loads one with a click and the system writes every value to the PLCs in one shot. Every load is audited.
recipes.load_confirm: This will write {{count}} values to the PLCs.

ask.revoke_key_desc: Edge boxes using it lose access immediately.
ask.remove_sso_desc: Users will no longer be able to sign in with this provider.
ask.remove_box_desc: Its key is revoked immediately and its {{count}} gateways go back to the server.
ask.delete_gateway_desc: Its tags are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
ask.delete_org_desc: Only possible once it has no sites left. This cannot be undone.
ask.delete_tag_desc: The tag stops being read from the PLC.
ask.delete_user_desc: They will no longer be able to sign in. Their actions stay in the audit log.
ask.delete_shift_desc: Operator assignments to this shift are removed.
ask.delete_recipe_desc: Past runs stay in the history.
ask.restore_desc: The current configuration is overwritten. This cannot be undone.
ask.restart_services_desc: Services restart in the right order. For a few seconds no data is read.
ask.write_value_desc: The value is sent to the PLC and acts on the plant.
ask.delete_site_desc: Only possible once it has no areas. This cannot be undone.
ask.delete_area_desc: Only possible once it has no gateways. This cannot be undone.
ask.restart_edge_desc: Every service on the box restarts: for a few tens of seconds that plant's PLCs are not read.

tags.pick_gateway: Pick a gateway first: a tag belongs to a specific PLC.
tags.overlap_title: Address already used by another tag
tags.reorder_failed: Could not change the order of the tags
tags.write_not_a_number: The value is not a valid number for type {{type}}.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.network: The server is not answering: check the network connection.
errors.status_400: Invalid request: check what you entered.
errors.status_403: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.status_404: Not found: it may have been deleted.
errors.status_409: Conflict: it already exists or is in use.
errors.status_429: Too many requests: try again shortly.
errors.status_504: The server took too long: try again.

empty.sites_desc: A site is a plant or location. It will hold areas (departments, lines) and the gateways that talk to the PLCs.
empty.sites_pick_org: Pick an organization at the top first, then create its first site.
empty.areas_desc: An area is a department or line inside a site: it will hold the gateways of its PLCs.
empty.areas_pick_site: Pick a site first, then create its first area.
empty.gateways_desc: A gateway is the connection to a PLC (Siemens S7, Modbus, OPC UA, MQTT…). Add one with the button at the top: you can test the connection before saving.
empty.gateways_pick_area: Pick an area first: a gateway belongs to a department or line.
empty.tags_desc: A tag is a variable read from the PLC (temperature, motor state…). Add them one at a time, browse them from the PLC, or import them from a file with the buttons at the top.
empty.tags_pick_gateway: Pick a gateway first: every tag belongs to a specific PLC.
empty.recipes_desc: A recipe is a set of values (speed, temperature, setpoint…) the operator writes to the PLCs in one click.
empty.shifts_desc: Shifts say when the plant works: they drive OEE by shift, reports and operator assignments.

cookies.text: We only use technical cookies, needed for the platform to work. No profiling or marketing cookies.
